description:
Free discovery: corpus-backed SELLER reputation for a merchant/provider wallet.

    Answers "is this provider organic, narrow, or a wash fleet?" from the merchant's
    inbound payment graph over the last 90 days: unique payers, repeat-payer %,
    heavy-fleet revenue concentration, captive-payer % (onboarding-sink proxy), and
    a scripted-fleet uniformity signal, and top_payer_tx_pct (captive
    concentration). Returns wash_label + reputation tier + wash_flagged
    (tri-state: true | false | null; null = never evaluated, not clean).

    Complements score_wallet_for_intel (payer side) with the seller side.
    wash_flagged=true never soft-allows (buyer refuse; preflight block). Fail-open:
    a DB gap returns wash_label/tier "unknown" AND wash_flagged=null (plus
    wash_confidence) - an unevaluated verdict, never a clean one. This is the free
    seller signal. First paid hop is GET /v1/intel/quick/{wallet} (0.001 USDC).
    Optional V7 renorm + signed receipt is GET /v1/intel/trust/{wallet} (0.05 USDC).

merchant.description: Seller/merchant Solana wallet public key (the pay_to address) to score on inbound corpus reputation.
merchant.title: Merchant

name: get_provider_reputation

captive_payer_pct.description: Percent of payers who pay ONLY this merchant (captive/onboarding-sink proxy).
captive_payer_pct.title: Captive Payer Pct

heavy_fleet_payers.description: Count of heavy single-counterparty fleet payers.
heavy_fleet_payers.title: Heavy Fleet Payers

heavy_fleet_revenue_pct.description: Percent of revenue from heavy-fleet payers.
heavy_fleet_revenue_pct.title: Heavy Fleet Revenue Pct

heavy_fleet_tx_cv.description: Tx-count uniformity across heavy-fleet payers; near-zero = scripted sybil fleet.
heavy_fleet_tx_cv.title: Heavy Fleet Tx Cv

merchant.description: The seller/merchant Solana wallet looked up.
merchant.title: Merchant

repeat_payer_pct.description: Percent of payers who paid more than once.
repeat_payer_pct.title: Repeat Payer Pct

top_payer_tx_pct.description: Percent of inbound settles supplied by the single largest payer (captive concentration; >=90 with volume floor flags wash; null = not computed).
top_payer_tx_pct.title: Top Payer Tx Pct

unique_payers.description: Distinct payers observed paying this merchant (90d).
unique_payers.title: Unique Payers

wash_confidence.description: "full" when self+reciprocal+ring ran; "base_2cycle" when the Base 2-cycle overlay ran but the live 3-cycle ring query did not return (not a full screen); "partial_inbound_only" when the circular-flow overlay did not run.
wash_confidence.title: Wash Confidence

wash_flagged.description: true = fleet/wash/captive/scripted-fleet signals tripped — never soft-allow (refuse / preflight block); false = evaluated and clean; null = never evaluated (unknown - do NOT coerce to false).
wash_flagged.title: Wash Flagged
